remarks: This majestic Colonial, part of a fine homes cul-de-sac neighb'hd, offers grand stylish space & brilliant design for living life to the fullest! Dramatic entrance foyer w/2-story ceiling & sweeping main staircase welcomes you. Gracious step-down Living rm w/one of the homes' 3-marble fpls is open to holiday-size formal Dining rm, while versatile Den/Office is across the hall. They introduce the homes' deep windows, detailed crown moldings & rich hardwood floors. EIK is open to fantastic 2-story Family rm w fpl & family staircase to BR level. Pvtly set Primary suite boasts stunning BR w/fpl, 2-very lg WI closets & deluxe marble bath w vltd ceiling, shower & jetted tub. 3-distinctive lg BRs, one w/bath en suite, 1-w/bonus rm & 2 sharing Jack 'n Jill bath + conv laundry rm finish 2nd flr. Expansive walkout LL has playrm that's currently used as cabaret(!), exercise rm, lg shelved rm & powder rm. Filled w/amenities+upgrades-see feature sheet. Welcome to YOUR DREAM HOM
